nodes.label: rot restated in the core-projected basis (row 58)
nodes.rationale: Excluding core shells from both the projection sum Dr and the I-matrix basis removes the symmetrized-M transpose halves <Pm|T|P_core>, so the F102.3 species / D1 mechanism cannot enter F(). Everything else is held identical to the sealed w102b so that only the basis change is under test.

nodes.label: D1 mechanism made falsifiable
nodes.rationale: PA.2 flips the 5s sign relative to sealed rot_w102b(5s)=+8.019e-05; a sign-exact clause is what turns the D1 attribution into something that can miss.

nodes.label: S104 §6 branch A / branch B fork
nodes.rationale: Branch B (de-symmetrized M, repaired T-action) runs ONLY if PA.3 misses. If PA.3 hits there is no competing method and branch B would be undeclared spend under the prime directive.

nodes.label: Declared can-fail (non-vacuous exercise of the computation path)
nodes.rationale: --canfail perturbs Dr_val at 6s so PA.3 MUST miss; rc=4 BREAK OK, rc=5 VACUOUS. A prediction whose instrument cannot miss scores nothing.
